meta.title: Teams
meta.description: Find a squad or build your own. Browse Gamer's Exile teams by game and region, see who's recruiting, and join with an invite link.
meta.newDescription: Start a team at Gamer's Exile: pick your game, set the roles you need, and invite your squad.
meta.teamDescription: {name} — a {game} team in {region} at Gamer's Exile.
meta.inviteDescription: You've been invited to join a team at Gamer's Exile.

browse.title: Find Your Squad
browse.lead: Every team in the community, by game and region. Recruiting teams list the roles they need — find a gap you can fill, or start your own.
browse.signInCta: Sign in to create a team
browse.emptyBody: Nothing matches those filters. Try another game or region — or be the first and start the team yourself.

form.name: Team name
form.tagHint: Optional. 2–5 letters or numbers, e.g. EXL.
form.gameHint: One team per game per player. The game can't be changed later.
form.descriptionHint: Up to 280 characters. Schedule, vibe, what you're aiming for.
form.recruitingHint: Show the team as looking for players.
form.openRolesHint: The roles you're looking for in this game.
form.discordHint: Needed so teammates can find you. Only members of your teams see it.

new.title: Raise Your Banner
new.lead: Name it, pick the game, list the roles you need. You'll be captain — invite links come next.

team.noDescription: This team hasn't written a description yet.
team.discordHidden: Discord usernames are visible to team members only.
team.joinHint: Want in? Teams grow by invite — ask the captain for a link.

member.title: Your place on the team
member.leaveConfirm: Leave {name}? You'll need a new invite to come back.
member.captainLeaveNote: Captains can't leave. Transfer the captaincy first, or disband the team.

captain.title: Captain's panel
captain.lead: Only you can see this. Changes apply immediately.
captain.noOthers: No one else on the roster yet — send an invite link.
captain.transferHint: Hand the team to another member. You stay on the roster as a player.
captain.transferConfirm: Make {name} captain? You'll lose captain controls.
captain.invitesHint: Anyone with a link can join until it expires or runs out of uses.
captain.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? It stops working immediately.
captain.disbandHint: Deletes the team, its roster and every invite link. This can't be undone.
captain.disbandType: Type the team name to confirm: {name}

invite.title: You're Invited
invite.lead: A captain sent you this link. Check the team out, then join the roster.
invite.signInHint: You need an account to join a team. You'll come straight back here.
invite.otherTeam: You already play {game} for {team}. Players can be on one team per game — leave that team first to join this one.
invite.invalidBody: The link may have expired, been revoked, or reached its limit. Ask the team captain for a fresh one.

errors.auth-disabled: Sign-in isn't available yet, so teams can't be changed right now.
errors.forbidden: Only the team captain can do that.
errors.invalid-input: Something in the form isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.description-length: Descriptions can be up to 280 characters.
errors.invalid-game: Choose a game from the list.
errors.invalid-region: Choose a region from the list.
errors.invalid-role: That role isn't available for this game.
errors.one-team-per-game: You're already on a team for this game. Players can be on one team per game.
errors.discord-required: Add your Discord username so teammates can reach you.
errors.invalid-discord: Discord usernames are 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ and .
errors.invite-invalid: This invite link has expired, been revoked, or is full.
errors.captain-cannot-leave: Captains can't leave. Transfer the captaincy or disband the team.
errors.cannot-remove-self: You can't remove yourself. Transfer the captaincy or disband instead.
errors.not-a-member: That player isn't on this team.
errors.confirm-mismatch: The name doesn't match. Type the team name exactly to confirm.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
